decks.notes: The main concept of this Grixis Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan with a mix of removal and hand disruption spells while generating card advantage through card draw and planeswalkers. The deck aims to control the board using cards like Baleful Strix and Swords to Plowshares, while also disrupting the opponent's hand with Hymn to Tourach and Inquisition of Kozilek. Additionally, the deck has access to powerful planeswalkers like Jace, the Mind Sculptor and Teferi, Time Raveler to help control the game and secure victory.

This deck aims to quickly generate mana through rituals, artifacts, and lands to cast multiple spells in a single turn and win the game by storming off with Tendrils of Agony or Burning Wish. It uses cantrips like Ponder and Brainstorm to dig for key pieces, protection with Veil of Summer, and additional combo enablers like Lion's Eye Diamond and Lotus Petal. The inclusion of Burning Wish allows for access to a sideboard full of powerful silver bullets that can be easily retrieved when needed to deal with specific threats or situations.

The deck focuses on using cheap spells and efficient creatures to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan while pushing damage through quickly. By utilizing card selection and countermagic to protect its threats, the deck aims to apply pressure constantly and force the opponent to respond to its threats while also disrupting their strategy. With a mix of burn spells, disruptive creatures, and powerful threats like Murktide Regent, the deck aims to efficiently close out games before the opponent can stabilize.

This deck focuses on utilizing lands as a resource to control the game. By exploiting cards like Life from the Loam, Crop Rotation, and Exploration, the player can manipulate their lands to generate mana advantage and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also includes elements of graveyard recursion with Endurance and Elvish Reclaimer, as well as removal options like Punishing Fire. The lands themselves play a crucial role in the deck's strategy, with utility lands like Grove of the Burnwillows, Maze of Ith, and Wasteland providing additional value and control over the battlefield.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly and efficiently cheat powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty into play from the graveyard using cards like Reanimate, Exhume, and Animate Dead. The deck seeks to disrupt the opponent's hand with cards like Grief and Thoughtseize while using efficient reanimation spells and mana acceleration like Dark Ritual and Lotus Petal to overpower them with big threats early in the game. The deck aims to win by overwhelming the opponent with its powerful reanimated creatures and disrupting their game plan with hand disruption spells.

This deck is focused on using low-cost, efficient creatures and spells to apply pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan. The deck relies on using cards like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler to quickly establish a board presence, while also utilizing counterspells like Force of Will and Daze to protect its threats. Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning provide additional removal options, while cards like Brazen Borrower and Murktide Regent offer versatility and resilience. The manabase is designed to support the aggressive tempo strategy with access to various colors of mana and land disruption tools like Wasteland.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by disrupting the opponent's plays with counterspells like Force of Will and Daze, while also applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler. The deck aims to quickly establish a board presence and close out the game before the opponent can stabilize. The inclusion of cards like Lightning Bolt and Murktide Regent provides additional reach and removal options. The mana base is designed to support the color requirements of the deck and to disrupt the opponent's mana base with cards like Wasteland.

The main concept of this deck is to assemble a powerful board of Elves in order to generate lots of mana with cards like Gaea's Cradle and Heritage Druid, and then use that mana to either cast big creatures like Craterhoof Behemoth or tutor for them using Green Sun's Zenith and Natural Order. The deck also includes cards like Allosaurus Shepherd to protect its combo pieces and cards like Glimpse of Nature to draw more cards and keep the engine going. This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with its aggressive Elf tribal strategy.

The main concept of this deck is to assemble a fast and aggressive game plan through a combination of disruptive spells, efficient creatures, and card selection. By efficiently using counterspells and removal to control the board while simultaneously pressuring the opponent with evasive threats like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler, the deck aims to quickly close out games before the opponent can establish their own game plan. The deck also utilizes cantrips like Ponder and Brainstorm to dig for key cards and maintain card advantage, allowing for consistent and powerful plays each turn.

The main concept of this Legacy UR Tempo deck is to maintain control over the game with cheap counterspells and disruption, while applying pressure with efficient threats like Murktide Regent and Dragon's Rage Channeler. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Daze and Pyroblast, while also digging through the deck for key cards with cantrips like Ponder and Brainstorm. The inclusion of Mishra's Bauble and Predict adds additional card advantage and deck manipulation to ensure the deck can stay ahead of the opponent.

The main concept of this Dragon Stompy deck is to aggressively disrupt opponents' game plans by using powerful red creatures and disruptive artifacts like Chalice of the Void, Trinisphere, and Blood Moon. By ramping out threats early with cards like Chrome Mox and Simian Spirit Guide, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm opponents and lock them out of the game with cards like Fireflux Squad, Legion Warboss, and Laelia, the Blade Reforged. The deck's focus on mana denial and aggressive creatures makes it difficult for opponents to mount a defense or recover once behind.

The key concept of this deck is to maintain tempo and aggressive pressure by quickly deploying threats like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent while disrupting the opponent's game plan with countermagic like Daze and Force of Will. The deck also aims to smooth out its draws and generate card advantage through cantrips like Ponder and Brainstorm, while efficiently removing opposing threats with Lightning Bolt and Pyroblast. Additionally, the inclusion of Wasteland helps to disrupt the opponent's mana base, further increasing the deck's advantage in the match-up.

The deck focuses on quickly casting a high volume of spells to mill the entire library and win the game with Thassa's Oracle. It includes cards that generate mana like Simian Spirit Guide and Dark Ritual, as well as cards that allow for quick, explosive plays such as Undercity Informer. The deck utilizes cards like Pact of Negation and Cabal Therapy for protection and disruption. By using these tools efficiently, the deck aims to assemble the combo and win in a single turn.

This deck focuses on controlling the opponent's resources while accumulating value through its lands. By utilizing cards like Life from the Loam, Crop Rotation, and Exploration, the deck can consistently generate mana advantage and lock down the opponent's board with cards like Dark Depths and The Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale. The deck can also disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Endurance and Punishing Fire, while also having the ability to fetch key lands with cards like Expedition Map and Urborg's Saga. Ultimately, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent through its land-based control strategy.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy by using disruptive creatures like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Spirit of the Labyrinth, and controlling the board with removal spells like Swords to Plowshares. It also utilizes Stoneforge Mystic to search for powerful equipment like Batterskull and Umezawa's Jitte to maintain pressure on the opponent. Additionally, the deck has ways to generate card advantage through Flickerwisp and Recruiter of the Guard, while also utilizing Aether Vial for mana efficiency. The overall strategy is to maintain control of the game while applying pressure on the opponent to secure victory.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's plays while utilizing powerful creatures and spells to maintain board presence and advantage. It aims to generate value from cards like Life from the Loam and Yorion, Sky Nomad, while disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares. The deck also features a toolbox approach with cards like Green Sun's Zenith and Prismatic Ending to deal with a variety of threats. Overall, the deck excels in controlling the game and out-valuing the opponent in longer matches.
